digest.component_or_area: Jira reconciler mutation differ and snapshot call-site filter
propositions: The raw compute_mutations API emits field_drift as a positive control when passed mismatched local and remote state, but the production snapshot call-site must filter these emissions because it incorrectly passes both arguments as remote Jira state.

A4-1 landed with call-site suppression of field_drift and unbound_local emissions; changing compute_mutations itself would break the load-bearing positive control and contradict the deliberate design decision.
The call-site filter preserves genuine inbound-create mutations and invariant repairs while eliminating spurious field_drift emissions from the production snapshot reconciliation path.
A converged reconciliation pass with the A4-1 filter records mutation_count == 0 and zero per-mutation git calls, proving no work is incorrectly suppressed.
